beats.story: I'm lying on the couch in a T-shirt and panties that are frankly ready for a demotion. The latest conga line of thoughts flash over me: Cliff -- the kiss, the car ride home; Armin -- his mom, the favor I owe him; Larry's face, etc.; the fucking blazer I ordered. As a coping mechanism, I move on to binge-watching some astronomy documentary, learning how big the universe is and how we are all teeny dust. It's right as I'm having an existential crisis about the point of life when my mom's picture takes over my phone screen, the ring vibrations drilling into my stomach. I hit silence, automatic as a bot. But the sound of Rhonda's miserable sigh every time she gets Carl's voicemail is dredged from my subconscious. I make like Caitlin and find the least offensive background, shoving a pile of clothes off the couch and posing the camera away from the open chip bag lying beside me. "Hello." "You're engaged?" is what she says, her tone incredibly even as she searches my face.
beats.story_cn: 我穿着T恤和一条坦白说已到了该退休级别的内裤瘫在沙发上。一连串思绪如跳绳般掠过心头：克里夫——那个吻，回家的车程；阿明——他妈妈，我欠他的人情；拉里的脸，等等；还有我他妈下单的那件西装外套。为转移注意力，我开始狂看天文纪录片，学习宇宙有多浩瀚，我们不过沧海一粟。正当我陷入存在主义危机、质疑人生意义时，我妈的照片霸占了手机屏幕，铃声震动得我胃里一阵翻腾。我像机器人一样本能地按了静音。但每次打卡尔电话听到他语音信箱时，朗达那声可怜的叹息却从潜意识里被打捞上来。我学凯特琳的样，找了最不碍眼的背景，把一堆衣服从沙发上扒拉开，把镜头转向旁边那袋敞着口的薯片的反方向。"喂。"

beats.story: I can barely follow, yet I know exactly what she's talking about. But shit. "So it's mistake?" she says again. "I knew it." But if I tell my mom it's a lie, that information will go all the way back down the gossip chain, back to Armin's mom. Dread curdles my stomach. If it becomes known that Armin lied to his poor sick mom, not only will he probably change his tune about keeping my email access secret, but his mom will probably freak out, and she's already frail enough. "It's, uh," I stumble, thinking on my feet, trying not to make eye contact through the screen. "It's not like an actual engagement.

The question comes from a tiny man holding a giant bouquet of chocolate-covered strawberries and mango on skewers. We can barely see his face as he tiptoes into the room, unsteady. "I'm looking for Caitlin Joffrey." Caitlin's face goes pink and she puts a hand to her chest, a perfect picture of modest delight. "Yes, that's me." "Oh, goodness." Rhonda stands up to examine the giant display as the man lowers in onto the worktable next to our desks. "Who is this from?" Caitlin walks over to the arrangement and pulls out the card. "Oh, it's my Kyle." Her smile is wide, her lipstick freshly applied. "That's so sweet.
beats.story_cn: 门口传来提示音，所有人的目光齐刷刷转过去。“请问凯特琳·乔芙瑞女士在这儿吗？”问话的是个小个子男人，怀里抱着硕大无比的花束——巧克力裹草莓配上竹签芒果。他踮着脚尖踉踉跄跄走进来，我们几乎看不清他的脸。“我在找凯特琳·乔芙瑞。”凯特琳的脸颊泛起绯红，一只手抚上胸口，那姿态活脱脱是“又惊又喜”的完美诠释。“对，是我。”“哎呀呀。”朗达起身凑近那捧夸张的花礼，男人正小心翼翼地将花束放在我们工位旁的办公桌上。“谁送的呀？”凯特琳走到花束前抽出卡片。“噢，是我的凯尔。”她咧开嘴笑了，唇膏是新补的。“太贴心了。”

beats.story: If I didn't know better, I'd say this is starting to look like an anxiety attack -- except this is Caitlin, so she's probably just dopamine drained since her last Instagram post (some brunch eggs she somehow deemed grid- worthy) didn't even reach twenty likes. Still, an odd tightness seeps in. Her phone buzzes again. She hits some button that seems to kill it and stuffs it in her purse. I turn back to my inbox, looking for a distraction. Cliff has a new notification from his LinkedIn account, which everyone knows is just a hookup site. Still, I click on it. The notification says there is a reply to a message sent to some guy named Sanjay Singh at People Power in Vancouver, dated yesterday afternoon.
beats.story_cn: 若非深知内情，这简直像焦虑症发作的前兆——不过对方是凯特琳，她大概只是因为最新那条Instagram动态（不知怎的竟觉得值得展示的早午餐鸡蛋）点赞没破二十，多巴胺枯竭罢了。尽管如此，某种异样的紧绷感仍在蔓延。她的手机再次震动。她按下某个键似乎关闭了提示，将手机塞进提包。我转回邮箱寻找分心之物。克里夫的领英账号弹出新通知——众所周知那不过是相亲网站。但我还是点开了。通知显示有人回复了他昨天下午发给温哥华人力公司某个叫桑杰·辛格的人的信息。

beats.story: CLIFF: Hey Sanjay, I can't believe it's been over a year. How are things going? I wanted to reach out. I left the insurance company and recently started at Supershops -- still HR. This place is a bit of a nightmare in all the ways we talk about and it's getting hard to tolerate. Because of this, I wanted to follow up about that open offer. Would you be available for a chat this week? Definitely best to do after work hours.
beats.story_cn: 克里夫：嘿桑杰，真不敢相信已经一年多没联系了。最近怎么样？我联系你是想告诉你，我离开了保险公司，最近刚到超级商城——还是做人力资源。这地方简直是噩梦，各种你懂的糟心事越来越难以忍受。正因如此，我想跟进之前那个未作数的邀请。这周能抽空聊聊吗？下班后时间最合适。
